name: signalbox
description: Transactional interlocking for AI agent actions

scripts.generated:build: cd generated/signalbox && npm install --omit=dev --no-package-lock && npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.modellang:typecheck: npm run modellang:build && npm run generated:build && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run host:build
scripts.start: npm run generated:build && npm run host:build && node dist/server.mjs
scripts.worker: npm run generated:build && npm run host:build && node dist/worker-main.mjs
scripts.agent: npm run generated:build && npm run host:build && node dist/agent-main.mjs
